Sandbox_ARR_RemoveSkillRequirements_tool: Any crafting or building recipe can be made regardless of skill level, as long as you have the ingredients and tools.
Sandbox_ARR_KnowAllRecipes_tooltip: Every recipe is known from the start. Turn off to still require magazines, journals and auto-learning to unlock recipes.
Sandbox_ARR_SkillTimeScaling_tooltip:
Hand crafting and building take longer when your skill is below the recipe's original requirement and less time when above it.
Time = base x (1 + percent)^(required - your level), averaged over all required skills.
Recipes without a skill requirement keep vanilla timing. Workstation crafting is not affected.
Sandbox_ARR_TimePercentPerLevel_tooltip: Compounding change per level of difference. With 15: 2 levels under = x1.32, 6 under = x2.31, 2 over = x0.76.
Sandbox_ARR_MaxTimeMultiplier_tooltip: Crafting never takes longer than base time times this value.
Sandbox_ARR_MinTimeMultiplier_tooltip: Crafting never takes less than base time times this value.
Sandbox_ARR_UnderskilledXpBonus_tooltip: Crafting or building a recipe above your skill level gives extra XP.
Sandbox_ARR_XpPercentPerLevel_tooltip: Compounding XP bonus per level you are below the requirement, averaged over all required skills. With 10: 3 levels under = x1.33 XP.
Sandbox_ARR_MaxXpMultiplier_tooltip: The XP bonus never goes above this multiplier.
Sandbox_ARR_ShowTimeModifier: Show time modifier in crafting menu
Sandbox_ARR_ShowTimeModifier_tooltip: Shows a line like "Under-skilled: x2.31 time" in the crafting menu.
